RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, March 20, 2013/Phalguna 29, 1934 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Culture; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour
and Employment; Social Justice and Empowerment; Textiles; Women and
Child Development; Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Memorandum by AP Government on
damage caused by cyclone 'Nilam'
*321. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government of Andhra
Pradesh submitted any Memorandum
outlining the damage caused by cyclone
'Nilam', which hit the State recently,
demanding funds from the National
Disaster Response Fund (NDRF); and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Action against hate speeches by
leaders
*322. DR. T. N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has taken note
of the hate speeches made by few leaders/
persons showing disrespect on grounds of
religion, race, birthplace, language, caste or
community or any other ground
whatsoever regularly so as to serve their
own ulterior motives, thereby disturbing
the peace of nation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the State-wise details of non-bailable
warrants pending against such persons and
the reaction of Government thereto; and
(d) the details of the steps taken by
Government to initiate strict action against
such persons to maintain peace and
harmony amongst citizens?
Mention of gangrape in Delhi in the
Verma Committee Report
*323. SHRI M.P. ACHUTHAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the J.S. Verma
Committee Report has mentioned an
incident of gangrape in its Appendices
Section as per which three cops in a PCR
van abducted a girl from near a temple
situated close to some old vacant building
and a ridge in Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any inquiry has been
conducted into the incident;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and

(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Construction of spillway piers over
Sardar Sarovar Dam
*324. SHRI DILIPBHAI PANDY A:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Gujarat has asked permission for taking up
Phase-I construction of spillway piers to
full height, bridge and installation of gates
over Sardar Sarovar Dam, Gujarat;
(b) if so, what steps have been taken by
Government for granting such permission;
(c) whether it is a fact that for the last
more than five years, nothing has been done
by Government for granting such
permission; and
(d) if so, the details of delay and time
by when permission will be given?
Promotion of Amateur Sports
*325. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is promoting
Amateur Sports;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Delay in projects of BRO
*326. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the road projects of the
Border Roads Organisation (BRO)
including the strategic border roads are
running behind schedule;
(b) if so, the details thereof indicating
the road projects which are delayed and
the reasons therefor;
(c) the funds allocated for these projects
during the last three years and the current
year; and
(d) the action being taken by
Government to complete the projects
without further delay?
Resignation of scientists
from DRDO
*327. SHRI PIYUSH GOYAL: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a significant number of
scientists have resigned from their posts in
the Defence Research and Development
Organisation (DRDO) during the last five
years;
(b) if so, the year-wise and post-wise
details thereof;
(c) whether low emoluments in DRDO
are the reasons for their resignation; and
(d) if so, what corrective steps are taken/
proposed to be taken by Government to
persuade the scientists not to resign?
Measures for rehabilitation of sex
workers
†*328. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
KASHYAP: Will the Minister of WOMEN
AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has issued any
advisory to States/Union Territories
regarding the measures to be taken to control
the trafficking of women and children for
sexual exploitation;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Supreme Court has

99
constituted a panel to suggest the measures
for the rehabilitation of 'sex-workers';
(d) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken by Government thereon along with
the present status thereof; and
(e) the other measures being taken by
Government in this regard?
Rate of prosecution and conviction in
cases of missing children
*329. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the

to state:
(a) the State-wise details of cases of
missing children registered during the last

Commitment to supply cotton
2481. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the foreign countries have
asked India to commit supply of lakhs of
bales of cotton each year to its fast-growing
garment industry; and
(b) if so, the country-wise details
thereof and the present status thereof
particularly the border countries?
Import of gold jewellery from
Thailand
2482. SHRI NAND KUMAR SAI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of gold jewellery
imported from Thailand during 2012-13 as
compared to corresponding period of
previous year;
(b) whether Government provides any
incentives for such import;
(c) if so, the details in this regard;
(d) whether Government proposes to
suspend import of gold jewellery from
Thailand; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Promotion of cultivation of turmeric in
Maharashtra
2483. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the year-wise details of production
of turmeric in the country during the last
three years;
(b) what was the share of Maharashtra
therein; and
(c) what promotional actions
Government propose to take to promote
cultivation of turmeric in Maharashtra in a
big way to tap the potential?

571
Financial assistance to rubber
producers by Rubber Board
2484. SHRI B.S. GNANADESIKAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Rubber Board proposes
to provide financial assistance to the rubber
producers and self-help groups to develop
primary infrastructure facilities for
strengthening the small holder sector;
(b) if so, whether the Rubber Board will
assist for productivity enhancement and
quality upgradation of produce in the small
holding sector; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the fiscal
allocation made by Government for this
purpose?
Regulating commercial usage of
ammonium nitrate
2485. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of legitimate fears of
classifying ammonium nitrate as a 'special
category explosive substance' under
Explosives Act, 1884;
(b) the details regarding constitution,
time of constitution, number of meetings
and views of Inter-Ministerial Committee
constituted to work on modalities to
regulate its commercial usage, handling,
storage and sale;
(c) the objections raised or received by
the Ministry to the idea of regulating the
commercial usage, handling, storage, sale
of ammonium nitrate;
(d) the number of ammonium nitrate
manufacturers in India; and
(e) the manner in which Government
ensures that ammonium nitrate sourced in
garb of overfly legitimate uses like
agriculture is not covertly directed by
subversive acts?
Import of pulses
†2486. SHRI RASHEED MASOOD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of import of gram,
yellow peas and arhar along with other
pulses as on date;
(b) the countries from where the import
has been made; and
(c) whether the price of import has been
higher than their minimum support price?
Extension of 2 per cent subsidy period
to export activities
2487. SHRI T.K. RANGARAJAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has a proposal
to extend the 2 per cent subsidy period to
export activities;
(b) if so, the details of the commodities
that fall under this proposal; and
(c) the reasons for provision of subsidy?
Assistance to Virginia tobacco farmers
2488. SHRI V . HANUMANTHA RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has plans to
help tobacco farmers by encouraging the
two-way export-import trade in Virginia
tobacco products;

(b) what are the total exports of
cigarettes to other countries in 2011-12;
(c) whether any study has been done
on how best to help farmers to getting them
access for exports to all other countries;
and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to increase un-restricted
access to Indian Virginia tobacco products
to other countries?

existing and fresh industries in North-
Eastern Region, Jammu and Kashmir and
Special Category States;
(b) the dates of expiry of each such
